title: Shared hazard values
description: The file game/tuning/hazards.json: values every hazard shares, read in both run modes. The file must exist; every field is optional, and a field left out keeps its default from core.drifters.base (DEFAULT_REHIT_COOLDOWN_TICKS 180, DEFAULT_REHIT_DIM 0.75). {} is a valid file. Key names are the GDD's (05-lives-and-damage.md, Values). Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app.md, Rules, Tuning loader) into core.drifters.tuning.HazardRules. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/drifters.md, Rules, The base, Re-hit cooldown.

rehit_cooldown.description: Ticks the hazard that took a life can't hit the ship again. Never scales with level. Default 180 (05-lives-and-damage.md, rehit_cooldown, guess). Maps to HazardRules.rehit_cooldown_ticks.

rehit_dim.description: Share of normal brightness a hazard is drawn at during its re-hit cooldown. 1 means no dimming. Default 0.75 (05-lives-and-damage.md, rehit_dim, guess). Maps to HazardRules.rehit_dim.
